title: onboard-cerulean-7b-v1.0-performance-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added Cerulean-7B v1.0 to the model registry with curated metadata, performance profiles for common sequence lengths, and automated changelog generation integration. No breaking changes. Users can now select "cerulean-7b:v1.0" from the model catalog. Performance profiles enable smarter default batching and quantization suggestions.
description:
Onboard Cerulean 7B v1.0: add metadata, performance profiles, and wire up changelog automation. Motivation: Cerulean is a high-quality open 7B model that fits our mid-tier latency/cost offering; adding it to the registry gives customers a calibrated runtime profile and enables automated release notes for model updates.

What this PR does:
- Adds canonical metadata (architecture, tokenizer, repo link, license, recommended quantization profiles) for cerulean-7b v1.0.
- Adds performance profiles (p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory footprint) for target sequence lengths [64, 256, 1024], generated from our perf lab runs.
- Integrates the new model into changelog/release-notes automation so future metadata/perf updates produce entry in the release notes.
- Adds lightweight tests and CI hooks to validate profile sanity and metadata schema.

Checklist:
- [x] Model metadata file (models/cerulean/metadata.yaml)
- [x] Perf profiles (models/cerulean/perf/profiles.json)
- [x] Changelog automation mapping (scripts/changelog-gen.py updated)
- [x] Unit tests for profile validation (tests/test_cerulean_profiles.py)
- [x] Documentation (docs/models/cerulean.md) and quickstart example

Testing and validation:
- Ran perf lab benchmarking jobs on the 4xA10 pool to generate profiles; results are attached to the internal run (ENG-4321).
- CI: model-registry-tests + lint + unit tests passed. One flaky integration test on GPU memory (CI job retried and passed).

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main and publish registry entry to staging.
2) Smoke test routing and canary a small percentage of traffic to cerulean in the dedicated pool.
3) Monitor cost/latency dashboards for regressions for 72h.

Notes and caveats:
- Perf profiles are conservative (rounded up memory and p95 latency) to avoid under-provisioning.
- Tokenization differences vs other 7B models documented in metadata to help downstream evaluation.

Related Linear tickets: ENG-4321 (onboard cerulean), PM-214 (product announcement)
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial metadata scaffold; perf profile import from perf-lab exports; changelog automation hook + tests; docs and quickstart example. Commits are small and focused to ease review.
